chunks: From him, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from Ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
In the salat, one iqamah suffices for you, except in the dawn prayer and the maghrib prayer.

key_terms.إِقَامَةٌ: the iqamah, the call marking the commencement of prayer

ai.seo_question: Is one iqamah sufficient for all prayers, or are fajr and maghrib exceptions?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the call to commence salat. It states that a single iqamah is sufficient in prayer generally, with an exception made for the dawn and maghrib prayers.
